newsitem.title: QATAR: SQUASH-JANSHER WINS FIFTH SUCCESSIVE QATAR TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SQUASH-JANSHER WINS FIFTH SUCCESSIVE QATAR TITLE.

text.p: Seven-time world champion Jansher Khan won his fifth successive Qatar International squash tournament on Thursday by defeating Australia's Rodney Eyles 15-10 15-7 13-15 15-10.
It took the Pakistani first seed 72 minutes to overcome the second seed in a re-match of the 1994 and 1995 finals here.
"I played some fantastic volleys today, and I was trying to finish the match quickly," Jansher said. "Eyles is always my toughest opponent and he's improved a lot."
The Australian argued with the referee throughout the contest and at one stage demanded the tournament referee be summoned courtside.
But after the match he played down his complaints.
"It was all a heat of the moment thing," he said. "But you have to give Jansher credit. I was trying to push and hound him but he keeps coming back."
Jansher said it was "75 percent certain" he would play in the Mahindra Challenge in India in December, a tournament he has avoided for the last three years because of fears for his safety.
Thursday's victory was Jansher's second against his old rival in recent weeks. He won the Al Gezira event in Egypt to avenge his shock defeat by Eyles in Hong Kong in August.
